Police Use Tear Gas on Highway in Ambala, Disrupting Traffic

Police in Ambala deployed tear gas shells on the Delhi-Amritsar highway on Tuesday. The action was taken to clear the highway, which had been blocked by protesters. The use of tear gas led to significant tension in the area. The highway, identified as NH-44, was reopened after the police intervention. The incident occurred near a school.
